items.name: ai-job-search
items.description: AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let Claude evaluate jobs, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare you for interviews.

descriptions.zh: 基于 Claude Code 构建的人工智能驱动的职位申请框架。叉开它，填写你的个人资料，让克劳德评估工作，定制简历，写求职信，并为你的面试做好准备。
descriptions.en: AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let Claude evaluate jobs, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare you for interviews.

items.name: U3-SDK

descriptions.zh: Unturned 的源代码，一款免费的开放世界僵尸生存沙盒游戏。
descriptions.en: Source code for Unturned, a free open-world zombie survival sandbox game.

descriptions.zh: AI 编码代理的生产级工程技能。
descriptions.en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

items.name: awesome-design-md
items.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.

descriptions.zh: 流行品牌设计系统的 DESIGN.md 文件分析集合。将一个项目放入您的项目中，让编码代理生成匹配的 UI。
descriptions.en: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.

items.name: OfficeCLI
items.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.

descriptions.zh: OfficeCLI 是第一个也是最好的 Office 套件，专为 AI 代理构建，用于读取、编辑和自动化 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件。免费、开源、单一二进制文件，无需安装 Office。
descriptions.en: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.

items.name: DesktopCommanderMCP
items.description: This is MCP server for Claude that gives it terminal control, file system search and diff file editing capabilities

descriptions.zh: 这是 Claude 的 MCP 服务器，为其提供终端控制、文件系统搜索和 diff 文件编辑功能
descriptions.en: This is MCP server for Claude that gives it terminal control, file system search and diff file editing capabilities
